cases_created_at_id_idx ordena el listado global de casos por fecha e id descendentes
SELECT count(*)::int AS total FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename='cases' AND indexname='cases_created_at_id_idx' AND indexdef LIKE '%(created_at DESC, id DESC)%'
cases_status_created_at_id_idx cubre el filtro de estado y el orden paginado
SELECT count(*)::int AS total FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename='cases' AND indexname='cases_status_created_at_id_idx' AND indexdef LIKE '%(status, created_at DESC, id DESC)%'
